gaps.explanation: Taxes (1,523,358) and Intergovernmental (1,476,207) agree exactly; the gap is in 'Local'. The budgetary comparison schedules print sale of surplus and insurance proceeds as Local receipts, while the governmental funds statement (p4, printed p7) and the General Funds combining statement (p5) print them under Other Financing Sources. Road Fund: budget schedule Local 21,896 (p10) vs statement Local 478 (p4) = 21,418 = Sale of surplus 21,418 (p4). General Fund: budget schedule Local 135,264 (p9) vs combining statement General Fund Local 134,486 (p5) = 778 = Insurance proceeds 778 (p4/p5). 21,418 + 778 = 22,196 = schedule 3,173,394 - statement 3,151,198. No detail fix.

Statement p4 Transfers in 505,000 = Road 465,000 + Non-Major 40,000; the statement's General Fund column combines General, Noxious Weed, U.S. Entitlement, Inheritance Tax and Library funds (p5-p6) and eliminates their transfers among themselves. Detail records them gross: General 253,000 (p9), Noxious Weed 108,000 (p5), Library 55,000 (p6), Road 465,000 (p10), Courthouse Building 40,000 (p8) = 921,000. Internal 253,000 + 108,000 + 55,000 = 416,000; 921,000 - 416,000 = 505,000. No detail fix.

Statement p4 Transfers out (505,000), General Fund column only (combined general funds). Detail gross: General (668,000) (p9) + U.S. Entitlement (253,000) (p5) = 921,000; transfers among the combined general funds 416,000 are eliminated on the statement: 921,000 - 416,000 = 505,000. No detail fix.
